REFERENCE AUDIT REPORT — references.bib
Date: 2026-05-23
Method: WebSearch verification of every bib entry against official publication records

TOTAL: 36 entries checked
ERRORS FOUND: 10 (in 8 entries)
FIXED: 10

========================================
FIXED ERRORS
========================================

1. [zhang2024minkpp] (Min-K%++)
   - AUTHORS: completely wrong. "Zheng, Jingwei; Gao, Jing; Miao, Chunyan" → "Sun, Jingwei; Yeats, Eric; Ouyang, Yang; Kuo, Martin; Zhang, Jianyi; Yang, Hao Frank; Li, Hai"
   - VENUE: "Proceedings of EMNLP" year 2024 → "Proceedings of ICLR" year 2025 (Spotlight)
   - Severity: CRITICAL (authors + venue + year all wrong)

2. [hao2025rewrite] (Learning to Rewrite)
   - AUTHORS: completely wrong. "Guan, Ran; Lu, Kangjie; Zhang, Shuai" → "Li, Ran; Zhao, Weiliang; Yang, Junfeng; Mao, Chengzhi"
   - VENUE: "Findings of ACL" → "Proceedings of ACL" (main conference, not Findings)
   - Severity: CRITICAL (authors + venue both wrong)

3. [alemohammad2024selfconsuming] (Self-Consuming Go MAD)
   - AUTHORS: 4 of 7 names were wrong, 1 author missing:
     "Luber, Lorenzo" → "Luzi, Lorenzo"
     "Babaei, Ahmed Imtiaz" → "Humayun, Ahmed Imtiaz" (different person)
     "Letizia, Daniel" → "LeJeune, Daniel"
     "Bastani, Osbert" → "Siahkoohi, Ali"
     Added missing author: "Babaei, Hossein" (7→8 authors)
   - Severity: CRITICAL (majority of author names hallucinated)

4. [dohmatob2024model] (A Tale of Tails)
   - AUTHOR NAME: "Yang, Pin-Yu" → "Yang, Pu" (Pin-Yu Chen is a different researcher at IBM)
   - Severity: MODERATE

5. [xie2023dsir] (DSIR)
   - TITLE: "Data Selection with Importance Resampling" → "Data Selection for Language Models via Importance Resampling"
   - VENUE: "Proceedings of ICML" → "Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems" (NeurIPS 2023)
   - Severity: HIGH (wrong title + wrong venue)

6. [tirumala2023d4] (D4)
   - AUTHORS: 2 of 4 names wrong. "Markosyan, Aram; Zettlemoyer, Luke" → "Simig, Daniel; Morcos, Ari"
   - Severity: HIGH

7. [wang2024semeval] (SemEval-2024 Task 8)
   - AUTHORS: 5 authors missing from the list. Added: Whitehouse, Chenxi; Aji, Alham Fikri; Habash, Nizar; Gurevych, Iryna; Nakov, Preslav
   - Severity: MODERATE (incomplete but not fabricated)

8. [schaeffer2025position] (Position: Model Collapse Does Not Mean What You Think)
   - AUTHOR NAME: "Arulandu, Anirudh" → "Arulandu, Alvan Caleb"
   - VENUE: "Proceedings of ICML" → arXiv preprint (paper is under review at NeurIPS 2025, not published at ICML)
   - Changed entry type from @inproceedings to @article
   - Severity: HIGH (wrong venue + wrong author name)

MINOR FIXES (title accuracy):
9. [basani2026diveye]: Removed non-official "DivEye:" prefix from title
10. [zawalski2026codec]: Removed non-official "CoDeC:" prefix from title
